name: SoundSteppedOut
where: Away and back tab, the away and back sound lists, and the Breaks tab's reminder sound list: SteppedOut's own sound, the first after Off and the one a sound from an earlier build becomes

name: SoundDrift
where: Away and back tab, the away and back sound lists: a warm, soft sound (falling when away, rising when back)

name: SoundPebble
where: Away and back tab, the away and back sound lists: a soft wooden sound (falling when away, rising when back)

name: SoundGlow
where: Away and back tab, the away and back sound lists: a soft bell (falling when away, rising when back)

name: SoundRipple
where: Away and back tab, the away and back sound lists: a few quick soft notes (falling when away, rising when back)

name: SoundDawn
where: Breaks tab, the reminder sound list: a soft chord that swells and fades

name: SoundMeadow
where: Breaks tab, the reminder sound list: a soft wooden sound, up and back

name: SoundLantern
where: Breaks tab, the reminder sound list: one soft bell note

name: SoundTide
where: Breaks tab, the reminder sound list: a warm, soft sound that rises and settles

name: YourOwnSound
where: the last row of each sound list: opens Windows' Open window to pick a .wav file on this PC; once one is picked, it shows in the list by its file name, just above this row

name: SoundFileFilter
where: Windows' Open window from Your own sound…: the kind of file listed, then the pattern after |

name: SoundOnAnotherPC
en: That sound is on another PC. Choose one saved on this PC.
ar: لا يمكن استخدام ملفات صوتية من الشبكة. اختر ملفًا محفوظًا على هذا الكمبيوتر.
where: in place of a sound row's explanation, after Your own sound… picks a file on a network path or network drive; the sound stays as it was

name: SoundTooBig
en: That file is over 5 MB. Choose a smaller sound.
ar: حجم الملف أكبر من 5 ميغابايت. اختر ملفًا أصغر.
where: in place of a sound row's explanation, after Your own sound… picks a file over 5 MB; the sound stays as it was

name: SoundTooLong
en: That sound is over 10 seconds. Choose a shorter one.
ar: مدة الصوت أطول من 10 ثوانٍ. اختر صوتًا أقصر.
where: in place of a sound row's explanation, after Your own sound… picks a sound longer than 10 seconds; the sound stays as it was

name: SoundCantPlay
en: SteppedOut can't play that file. Choose a .wav sound saved on this PC.
ar: يتعذر على SteppedOut تشغيل هذا الملف. اختر ملفًا صوتيًا بصيغة ‎.wav محفوظًا على هذا الكمبيوتر.
where: in place of a sound row's explanation, after Your own sound… picks a file that is not a .wav sound Windows plays, or can't be read; the sound stays as it was
